# Flow 0 · Set provider (first screen)

Back to the guide: [README.md](README.md) · all cases: [TEST-CASES.md](TEST-CASES.md). Mark each case in the app with `/tests` (p / f / s).

## 0 Set provider (first screen)

While no AI provider is set, Reconix asks first: "Set an AI provider?".
Use the mock model (offline) gives prepared answers on this computer: no key, no network. Set a provider… opens /provider. Skip starts with built-in replies only.
Start Reconix with the run-eval script (README-<your OS>.md §2). To see the first screen again: quit (Ctrl+Q), then start it with --reset (Windows: -Reset). That only clears ~/.reconix-eval, never your own ~/.reconix; export your /tests results first.

#### PROV-01 · Use the mock model without a key

1. Start Reconix fresh (run-eval with --reset).
2. "Set an AI provider?" → Use the mock model (offline) (press Enter).
3. The Reconix mock (offline) form opens: leave API key empty → Save provider.

**Expected:** A note says "Active model: Reconix mock (offline) · reconix-mock-1". The top bar shows llm: Reconix mock (offline) · reconix-mock-1 ● and the Start screen is ready.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip

#### PROV-02 · A fake key is masked

1. Quit, start Reconix fresh (run-eval with --reset).
2. Use the mock model → API key: sk-mock-0000-1234 → Save provider.
3. Type /provider and look at Reconix mock (offline).

**Expected:** Only sk-…1234 is shown: in the provider list, the form and anywhere else. The full key never shows.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip

#### PROV-03 · Skip, and the question comes back

1. Quit, start Reconix fresh (run-eval with --reset).
2. Choose Skip (built-in replies only).
3. Type: who are you?
4. Quit (Ctrl+Q) and start Reconix again (run-eval, without --reset).

**Expected:** The top bar shows llm: off. The answer is the built-in one and ends with "No AI model is set: /provider sets one…". At the next start Reconix asks again.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip

#### PROV-04 · No question once a model is set

1. With the mock set (PROV-01), quit and start Reconix again (without --reset).

**Expected:** No question: the Start screen opens at once and the top bar shows the mock.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip

#### PROV-05 · Unset the mock

1. /provider → Reconix mock (offline) → Unset → Yes, remove it.
2. Quit and start Reconix again (without --reset).

**Expected:** The top bar shows llm: off, and at the next start Reconix asks again.

Result: ☐ Pass ☐ Fail ☐ Skip
